# SpikeBasedTemporalAttention

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An attention mechanism implemented with spiking neurons that processes temporal sequences of spike events to capture gesture dynamics. Bridges transformer-style global context with spike-based temporal processing, enhancing accuracy in neuromorphic gesture recognition.
